description: 한국가스안전공사_KGS Code(상세기준) 개정 내역(수소법) [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국가스안전공사. KGS CODE는 가스관계 법령에서 정한 기술적인 사항(시설, 기술 등)을 상세기준으로 정하여 코드화 한 것으로 가스기술 기준위원회에서 심의, 의결 후 산업통상자원부에서 승인한 가스안전. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국가스안전공사. Its tags are 수소가스, 시설기준, 코드 개정, 고압가스, LPG. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
